godot_cpu_rest_bounds.method: CPU linear skinning: skeleton_world * sum(weight * bone_global_rest * inverse_bind * vertex)

visual_observations: Rest silhouette retains a closed helmet, layered shoulder/hip/knee plates, gold edging and divided short burgundy cloth.
No halo or weapon is fused into the body. Three views show front/side/back of the normalized candidate.
Finger shape is not fully separable in these 640px views and is not accepted as final gripping topology.
not_approved: Project-authored combat clips and whole-game state mapping
Cloth/armor/finger deformation through movement and attacks
Weapon grip, gait speed and foot contact
Final bronze material response and in-game lighting
Target hardware performance and final AAA art quality
reviewer_note: Blender importer bone-display Icosphere is excluded by the shared reviewer; it is not part of the source GLB mesh.
